purpose: Prevent development cohorts, identities or result artifacts that have already informed model/policy choices from later being relabelled as fresh final evidence.

locked_test.claim_rule: No final untouched claim may be made without an independent custodian attestation.

inspected_sets.name: public_new_crossing_development_roles
inspected_sets.description: Fit/calibration/threshold/score roles constructed from the public SEP-Prediction-V2 aggregate table and CLEAR event catalogue have been repeatedly used for development, threshold selection and diagnostics.

minimum_attestation: statement that identities/outcomes were not exposed to development
overlap check against this registry and any later registry versions
future_untouched_rule.if_attestation_unavailable: Describe evaluation as retrospective/development, not untouched or final superiority evidence.

maintenance_rule: Append every subsequently inspected cohort, comparator output, outage block result or policy-selection dataset before it can influence development decisions. Never delete an inspected entry because a result is negative or obsolete.
